title: Expected number of satisfied three-literal clauses
statement: Let $V$ be a finite set and let $\mathcal{C}$ be a finite multiset of clauses, each on three distinct variables, with each variable appearing either positively or negated. A clause is satisfied when at least one of its literals is true. Under a uniformly random Boolean assignment to $V$, the expected number of satisfied clauses in $\mathcal{C}$ is $7|\mathcal{C}|/8$.
hypotheses_covered: The clauses form a finite multiset
Each clause has an injective scope of three variables
Each clause specifies a polarity for each of its three literals
